$comment: F7.4 drafting gold set. A draft counts as accepted (an automated proxy for 'accepted without material change', PRD FR-14.10) when the citation gate keeps every sentence (nothing removed, not refused) and every required fact appears in a kept sentence. Citation precision is the share of cited sentences the gate keeps. The consultant's real acceptance rate is measured in the pilot (E4).

passages.text: Mean peak tensile force of the shaft-to-hub bond was 42.0 N (n = 30), above the 15 N acceptance criterion.
Samples are conditioned for 2 hours at 37 C in saline before tensile testing.
Ethylene oxide sterilization was validated by the overkill half-cycle method per ISO 11135. All biological indicators in the half cycle were negative, supporting a sterility assurance level of 10^-6.
Ethylene oxide and ethylene chlorohydrin residuals were measured per ISO 10993-7; all results were below the tolerable contact limits for a limited-exposure device.
Packaged samples are aged at 55 C per ASTM F1980 to simulate 2 years of real-time shelf life, then tested for seal strength and package integrity.
Dye penetration: 0 of 60 aged pouches showed channels. Seal strength mean 1.4 N/15 mm, minimum 1.1 N/15 mm.
In vitro cytotoxicity per ISO 10993-5 (MEM elution): the test article extract scored grade 0; the device is non-cytotoxic.
Hemolysis (direct and indirect contact) per ASTM F756: hemolytic index 0.4%, classified non-hemolytic.

items.heading: Performance testing - bench: connectors and flow

passages.text: Small-bore luer connector testing per ISO 80369-7: leakage, separation from axial load and resistance to overriding all passed.
Gravity flow rate with saline at 100 cm head height: mean 32 mL/min, all samples within the labeled 28-36 mL/min range.
